7. EV pilot will not implement EV issue solution or workaround; EV finds issue will be known issue to get MSFT's approval to wavie for EV pilot build start. 
etc. EV ME chassis S&V test, EV thermal HSINK, BIOS/BMC know issue...

pfams.assumptions:
Assumption & Risk assessment: 
1. Assume to build with DV PCBA (Blue PCB color) + NCT -> Hard tool chassis + PC CPU (w/ MSFT Key)
2. Assume WW can receive extra consigned 40 12 pcs of PC CPU w/security boot ver. for HQ R&D by 3/18 -> 4/30, 2026 5/18, 2026. 
3. Base on MUEFI/AMI integration + Wiwynn validation take EV BB + ES2 needs 5wks ahead to be received AGESA 0080
4. AMD/AMI AGESA code release by 3/2 -> 3/25 4/10, 2026, MSFT Grace confirmed MUEFI integrate/validation can completed before 5/18, 2026 for WW bring up. 
5. Assume WW receive PC CPU + MSFT MUEFI package to build BIOS & BMC sanity check for MSFT to sign off and release by 3/26 -> 5/14 5/29, 2026. 
6. Assume WW BIOS validation duration 3.5 weeks (BVT 3 days + FVT 3 weeks). 
7. Assume no CRD change between SKU qual/GR/VR including BSL/MDaaS test. 
8. Assume all SKU qual/GR/VR assembly greenlight depends on MSFT CRD confirmation and MSFT official ECO will release on next 1 week.
9.Assume no critical issue from DV validation as it is in parallel with DV pilot SKU qual and GR/VR build(DV pilot first build is 2 weeks after DV validation) WW mitigation: prepared 8pcs with EV + DV HPM + ES2 for QE/STE derisk, along with build in WYLZ to have HQ Eng easily support on debug.  
10.DV pilot will not implement DV BB issue solution or workaround; DV finds issue will be known issue to get MSFT's approval to wavie for DV pilot build start. 
ex: DV ME chassis S&V test, DV thermal HSINK, BIOS/BMC know issue...
11. BSL/MDaaS team accepted to use SR with 2 blades without PoT/MFG test but pre-check to start pre BSL/MDaaS development.
12. Assume VR build with  no SKU qual issue/GR PoT/GR MFG test issue gating as GR PoT/MFG test shorten to 5 days (original is 10days) and in parallel with SKU Qual P1/P2.
13. Assume no MDaaS test issue gating as MDaaS process and BSL test with the condition 1 rack 2 blades and only pre-check (w/o PoT & MFG test).
14. Assume enough time for Final FAI and MFG test log review in 1 day (original is 3days).

pfams.assumptions:
Assumption & Risk assessment: 
1. Assume to build with PV PCBA (Green PCB color) + tooling chassis + PR CPU.
2. Assume WW can receive 30 pcs of PR CPU for HQ R&D by 7/20, 2026.
3. Assume AMD/AMI AGESA code release by 6/15, 2026 to MSFT MUEFI integrate/validation to WW by 7/20, 2026. 
4. Assume WW receive PR CPU + MSFT MUEFI package to build BIOS & BMC sanity check for MSFT to sign off and release by 8/3, 2026. 
5.  Assume WW BIOS validation duration 3.5 weeks (BVT 3 days + FVT 3 weeks). . 
6. Assume no CRD change between SKU qual/GR/VR including BSL/MDaaS test. 
7. Assume all SKU qual/GR/VR assembly greenlight depends on MSFT CRD confirmation and MSFT official ECO will release on next 1 week.
8. DV BB validation and PV BB layout motification/PV gerber out/PV build are in parallel with TTM pilot SKU qual and GR/VR build.  
9. TTM pilot will not implement DV issue solution or workaround; DV finds issue will be known issue to get MSFT's approval to wavie for TTM pilot build start. 
etc. DV ME chassis S&V test, DV thermal HSINK, BIOS/BMC know issue...
10.  PV validation  is in parallel with PV 96c pilot SKU qual and GR/VR build. WW mitigation: WYLZ early build SKU qual, SR & GR can refer to P1/P2 result, VR can refer to full SKU qual result.
11. Assume CRD no change between 1st 20racks/ 2nd 40racks, since 1st VR in parallel go with phase 2nd GR, to make all dock before 2027/Jan/E.
12. Assume no change between scout board and volume board.
